result_text:
Instrumented model requests no longer crash when tool definitions or request parameters contain lone surrogates.

The `gen_ai.tool.definitions` and `model_request_parameters` attributes were built with `to_json`. I switched both to the existing surrogate-tolerant `safe_to_json` in `_instrumentation.py`. I also changed its parameter type from `Any` to `object`. Its behaviour is the same, and ordinary text without surrogates serialises as before.

I added a regression test in `tests/models/test_instrumented.py`. It uses the description `'get the weather before\udce4after'`. It checks that `request(...)` doesn't raise and that the parsed description equals the original string. It also checks that `function_tools[0].name` is `'weather'` in `model_request_parameters`.

The new test failed with the fix stashed. `tests/models/test_instrumented.py` passes with the fix, but I didn't run the rest of the test suite, lint or typecheck.
